corroborating_source.instrument: Loi de finances n° 35-05 pour l'année budgétaire 2006, promulguée par le dahir n° 1-05-197 du 24 kaada 1426 (26 décembre 2005)
corroborating_source.corroboration_note: The bulletin text of Article 101 is word-for-word the same as the LAR 2006 text on printed folios 95-96, checked item by item against all 38 rows. The PDF served at this URL is byte-identical to the local BO_5382-bis_fr.pdf (same SHA-256), so this snapshot has a live primary source and not only the DGI PDF and third-party mirror recorded above.
corroborating_source.article_numbering_note: The 2006 text numbers the TVA rate articles differently from the 2007 and later consolidated editions: 2006 Article 99 = base by prior agreement, Article 100 = 20% normal rate, Article 101 = reduced rates (7/10/14%), Article 102 = specific rates. In 2007 and later those same four articles are numbered 97, 98, 99 and 100. A 2006 Article 100 is therefore NOT the article exposed by tva_article100, and a 2006 Article 101 is NOT a CGI Article 99 edition.

retrieval_note: The cover identifies the DGI and cites Article 6 of Loi de finances n° 35-05 for 2006. This local mirror copy contains 235 PDF pages and ends at printed folio 235/241; it is not claimed byte-identical to the DGI-hosted PDF. Article 101 is complete on printed folios 95–98 and was visually checked against this copy. The DGI-hosted edition was also opened and its Article 101 text checked.
